abstract_sentences.text: Reasoning over long contexts is essential for large language models.

evidence.anchor: Reasoning over long contexts is essential

abstract_sentences.text: While reinforcement learning (RL) enhances short-context reasoning by inducing “Aha” moments in chain-of-thought, the advanced thinking patterns required for long-context reasoning remain largely unexplored, and high-difficulty RL data are scarce.

evidence.anchor: advanced thinking patterns required for long-context reasoning remain largely unexplored

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we introduce LoongRL, a data-driven RL method for advanced long-context reasoning.

evidence.anchor: we introduce LoongRL, a data-driven RL method

abstract_sentences.text: Central to LoongRL is KeyChain, a synthesis approach that transforms short multi-hop QA into high-difficulty long-context tasks by inserting UUID chains that hide the true question among large collections of distracting documents.

evidence.anchor: transforms short multi-hop QA into high-difficulty long-context tasks

abstract_sentences.text: Solving these tasks requires the model to trace the correct chain step-by-step, identify the true question, retrieve relevant facts and reason over them to answer correctly.

evidence.anchor: trace the correct chain step-by-step

abstract_sentences.text: RL training on KeyChain data induces an emergent plan–retrieve–reason–recheck reasoning pattern that generalizes far beyond training length.

evidence.anchor: induces an emergent plan–retrieve–reason–recheck reasoning pattern

abstract_sentences.text: Models trained at 16K effectively solve 128K tasks without prohibitive full-length RL rollout costs.

evidence.anchor: Models trained at 16K effectively solve 128K tasks

abstract_sentences.text: On Qwen2.5-7B and 14B, LoongRL substantially improves long-context multi-hop QA accuracy by +23.5% and +21.1% absolute gains.

evidence.anchor: improves long-context multi-hop QA accuracy by +23.5% and +21.1%

abstract_sentences.text: The resulting LoongRL-14B reaches a score of 74.2, rivaling much larger frontier models such as o3-mini (74.5) and DeepSeek-R1 (74.9).

evidence.anchor: reaches a score of 74.2

abstract_sentences.text: It also improves long-context retrieval, passes all 128K needle-in-a-haystack stress tests, and preserves short-context reasoning capabilities.

evidence.anchor: passes all 128K needle-in-a-haystack stress tests
Code is available at https://loongrl.github.io/

experimental_design.name: GRPO 与超参数

final_judgment.single_storyline: Real short multi-hop QA is expanded with distractors and hidden by non-semantic KeyChain chains; GRPO with boxed substring reward induces plan–retrieve–reason–recheck, and mixed data preserves short skills while 16K training transfers to 128K.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: KeyChain pipeline, three construction principles, GRPO objective/reward, Table 1 recipe, training/evaluation protocol, Tables 2-6, and Figures 1-4 remain in the main text because they carry the principal decisions.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Exact prompt, data skeleton, long traces, LongBench-v2, RULER prompt/YaRN protocol, 14B NIAH, UUID ablation, and checkpoint skill analysis move to A.2-A.11; these details are needed for full reproducibility and boundary interpretation.
final_judgment.best_pattern: The same-question trajectory pair in Figure 1, three-step construction diagram in Figure 2, matched replacement ablations in Tables 5-6, and length-separated Table 4 form the most effective evidence sequence.
final_judgment.largest_gap: The emergent behavior and cost claim rely on a few manual traces, response-length curves, and a KeyChain replacement; there is no behavior annotation set, randomized mechanism intervention, full-length cost control, verifier audit, seed variance, or task-level uncertainty.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: A paper claiming a new reasoning behavior should connect a reproducible data transformation, same-task contrast, component replacement, out-of-length test, and capability-retention test in one evidence chain, while quantifying behavior labels and failures.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: This rule fits outcome-verifiable QA RL with controllable data transformations; open-ended generation, unverifiable objectives, deployment latency, and safety claims require evidence beyond substring reward, pass@1, and illustrative traces.

theory_summary.role: The theory module supplies the GRPO objective, group-relative advantage normalization, and binary reward constraint as part of the training causal chain; it does not provide a convergence theorem or complexity proof.

narrative_summary.abstract_function_order: object_scope/problem_gap → core_idea/method → emergent pattern → 16K-to-128K and benchmark numbers → retrieval/retention → code.
narrative_summary.introduction_chain: context → failure_of_prior_work → missing_insight → scarce data/verifier/compute/forgetting problem → KeyChain and verifier → result preview.
narrative_summary.related_work_positioning: Taxonomy of short-context RL and long-context synthesis leads to nearest-neighbor contrast with QwenLong-L1 and a high-quality RL-data gap.
narrative_summary.statistical_boundary: Point estimates of accuracy, average score, average pass@1, reward, response length, and heatmap accuracy; no uncertainty intervals or hypothesis tests.
